home.intro: Open-source detection engineering, malware triage, and security automation. Browse the rule library or test files against YARA rules in your browser.

scanner.title: Live Scanner
scanner.subtitle: Compile YARA rules and scan files in-memory, or enrich IOCs against public threat intelligence sources.
scanner.rateLimit: Rate limited to 10 scans per IP per hour.
scanner.privacy: Files are processed in memory only and discarded after the response is returned. No file contents, hashes, or IPs are logged.
scanner.uploadHint: Drop a binary, document, or script to test against the rule below.
scanner.ruleHint: Paste or modify a rule. Validated with yara-x.
scanner.noMatches: No rules matched the supplied data.
scanner.iocLabel: Paste IOCs (one per line). Auto-detect supports IPv4, domains, URLs, MD5/SHA1/SHA256.
scanner.noIocs: No valid IOCs detected in input.

detections.title: Detection Library
detections.subtitle: YARA rules and KQL queries mapped to MITRE ATT&CK. Copy, fork, or test against the live scanner.
